selected.note: H4: H3 with exact population_served_count replaced by 7 LCR regulatory size classes (<=100, 101-500, 501-3300, 3301-10k, 10k-50k, 50k-100k, >100k). Hypothesis: population matters through sampling-tier size class, not as a fine-grained quasi-identifier of systems; coarse classes should lose nothing and remove any system-fingerprint memorisation. Lab: VAL 0.8124, contiguous backtests 0.7894 (= H3), 5y-gap 0.7767 (= H3); no population at all loses ~0.011.
